caption: Table 29-8. Clinical signs associated with hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism.
rows: Nervous, hyperactive to lethargic, excess vocalization, aggressive, heat intolerance
Lethargy, mental dullness, inactivity, cold intolerance
Normal or corneal lipid deposits, corneal ulceration/uveitis
Normal to decreased with possible dysrhythmias
Weakness, tremors, ventriflexion of head, muscle wasting
Seizures, ataxia, circling, vestibular signs, weakness, knuckling, facial nerve paralysis
